answer: Every claim climbs the juniper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the walnut re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Reaching the whisper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, slashed on a failed audit, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
